scenes.title: Campaigns and marketing
scenes.subtitle: Bring past travellers back
scenes.narration: Your past travellers are your best next customers. Marketing in TravelCRM Pro helps you reach them, politely.
The marketing dashboard shows what every campaign sent, how many opened and clicked, and which offers worked.
Open a campaign to see its audience, the message and its results.
Write a new one, choose a segment, and send it now or schedule it for later. Every send checks consent first.
Segments are audiences built from rules, like Bengaluru families interested in Kerala. Preview who matches before you save.
Make an offer flyer from a template in a couple of minutes, in your own colours and with your logo.
Festival offers come up ahead of each season, ready to turn into a campaign.
On Pro and Enterprise, send WhatsApp broadcasts with approved templates. Each one includes an unsubscribe link and skips anyone without consent.
When someone unsubscribes from a message, they land on the opted-out list, and no campaign reaches them again.
Two automations keep the relationship warm: one asks for a review after the trip, the other reaches out to customers who have not travelled for a while.

scenes.headline: Your next booking is a past traveller.
scenes.narration: TravelCRM Pro. Your next booking is often a past traveller.
